products.name: BMAD
products.rationale: Spec-first agent harness for turning vague goals into disciplined execution. Enforces planning, checkpointing, and quality gates before implementation begins.

conceptMappings.why: Strongest spec-first harness for turning vague goals into disciplined execution.
Best spec-first implementation loop when requirements discipline matters most.

products.name: GSD
products.rationale: Context-lifecycle harness with explicit checkpoints, budget control, and resume semantics. Best for durable multi-step agent execution.

conceptMappings.why: Best context-lifecycle harness with checkpoints, budget control, and resume semantics.
Best explicit checkpoint/resume model for recovering work without losing context.

products.name: LangGraph
products.rationale: Graph-based agent orchestration framework. Defines agent workflows as cyclic graphs with state management and tool execution.

conceptMappings.why: Most explicit graph-based control loop for stateful agent execution.
Features built-in central state persistence for branching, time travel, and durable execution.

products.name: Claude Code
products.rationale: Agentic coding assistant with CLI, desktop, and IDE interfaces. Orchestrates multi-step coding tasks with tool use, file editing, and terminal execution within a governed session.

conceptMappings.why: Full agentic harness with planning, tool use, checkpointing, and human-in-the-loop approval.
Native tool calling with MCP integration, bash execution, file I/O, and web fetching.
First-class MCP client supporting stdio and SSE transports for extensible tool integration.
Permission system with allow/deny rules, hook-based validation, and sandboxed execution.

products.name: Claude Desktop
products.rationale: Desktop chat interface for Claude with MCP server support, file/image upload, and project-scoped conversations. Consumer-facing experience layer for Anthropic models.

conceptMappings.why: MCP client enabling local tool servers for file access, database queries, and custom integrations.
Project-scoped memory and conversation context management across sessions.

products.name: Claude API
products.rationale: Foundation model API providing inference for Claude model family. Supports tool use, vision, extended thinking, and streaming. The compute substrate that other Anthropic products build on.

conceptMappings.why: Native function calling with structured JSON schemas for tool definitions and invocations.

products.name: OpenAI API
products.rationale: Foundation model API for GPT and o-series models. Supports function calling, vision, embeddings, and assistants. The dominant commercial inference platform.

conceptMappings.why: Pioneered structured function calling with JSON schema definitions in the chat completions API.

products.name: OpenAI Assistants API
products.rationale: Managed agent runtime with built-in threads, file search (RAG), code interpreter, and tool execution. Opinionated orchestration layer that handles state, memory, and tool dispatch.

conceptMappings.why: Managed harness with threads, runs, and built-in tool dispatch — but limited customization.
Built-in file search with vector store for retrieval-augmented generation.
Thread-based conversation memory with automatic context management.

products.name: ChatGPT
products.rationale: Consumer and enterprise chat interface with GPTs (custom agents), plugins, code interpreter, and web browsing. The dominant L7 experience surface for AI interactions.

conceptMappings.why: GPTs enable custom personas with instructions, knowledge files, and tool configurations.
Actions (formerly plugins) enable external API integrations via OpenAPI specs.

products.name: Vertex AI
products.rationale: Google's unified ML platform spanning model hosting, fine-tuning, evaluation, and agent building. Provides Gemini model endpoints, Model Garden, and Agent Builder for full-stack AI development.

conceptMappings.why: Agent Builder provides managed agent orchestration with grounding, tool use, and extensions.
Built-in safety filters, grounding checks, and responsible AI configuration.

products.name: Gemini API
products.rationale: Google's foundation model API for Gemini models. Supports multimodal input, function calling, code execution, and grounded generation. Available via AI Studio and Vertex AI.

conceptMappings.why: Native function calling with automatic or manual tool invocation modes.

products.name: IBM watsonx.ai
products.rationale: Enterprise AI platform with Granite model family, prompt engineering studio, fine-tuning, and watsonx.governance for AI lifecycle management. Strong focus on regulated industries.

conceptMappings.why: watsonx.governance provides model risk management, bias detection, drift monitoring, and audit trails for regulated environments.
Content filtering, PII detection, and hallucination mitigation built into the platform.

products.name: Azure OpenAI Service
products.rationale: Enterprise-grade OpenAI model hosting on Azure with content filtering, private networking, managed identity, and compliance certifications. Adds enterprise governance to OpenAI models.

conceptMappings.why: Azure Content Safety provides configurable content filtering, jailbreak detection, and prompt shields.
Enterprise RBAC, audit logging, data residency controls, and compliance certifications (SOC2, HIPAA).

products.name: Amazon Bedrock
products.rationale: Managed multi-model platform with Agents, Knowledge Bases (RAG), Guardrails, and model evaluation. Provides serverless access to Claude, Llama, Titan, and other foundation models on AWS.

conceptMappings.why: Bedrock Agents provide managed orchestration with action groups, knowledge bases, and return control.
Knowledge Bases provide managed RAG with automatic chunking, embedding, and vector store integration.
Bedrock Guardrails enforce content policies, PII filtering, topic denial, and word filters.

products.name: CrewAI
products.rationale: Multi-agent orchestration framework using role-based agents with hierarchical or sequential process flows. Emphasizes agent personas and delegation patterns.

conceptMappings.why: Agents defined by role, goal, and backstory — strongest persona-driven orchestration model.
Sequential and hierarchical process flows with task delegation between specialized agents.

products.name: AutoGen
products.rationale: Multi-agent conversation framework with customizable agent types, group chat patterns, and code execution. Supports human-in-the-loop and nested agent conversations.

conceptMappings.why: Conversation-based control loop with multi-agent group chat and round-robin patterns.
Agents can register and execute functions, code blocks, and external tools.

products.name: Semantic Kernel
products.rationale: Enterprise AI orchestration SDK for .NET, Python, and Java. Provides planner, plugin system, memory connectors, and process framework for building AI agents in enterprise codebases.

conceptMappings.why: Kernel + planner + plugins form a lightweight harness for enterprise AI orchestration.
Pluggable memory connectors for vector stores, enabling semantic recall across conversations.

products.name: LangChain
products.rationale: Composable framework for building LLM applications. Provides chains, agents, tool integrations, document loaders, and output parsers. The most widely adopted LLM integration layer.

conceptMappings.why: Largest ecosystem of tool integrations, document loaders, and output parsers for LLM applications.
Comprehensive RAG pipeline with document loaders, text splitters, retrievers, and chain compositions.

products.name: LangSmith
products.rationale: LLM observability and evaluation platform. Provides tracing, prompt playground, dataset management, automated evaluation, and annotation queues for monitoring agent quality.

conceptMappings.why: Online evaluation rules can gate or flag agent outputs based on quality criteria.

products.name: Pinecone
products.rationale: Managed vector database optimized for similarity search at scale. Provides serverless and pod-based indexes, metadata filtering, and sparse-dense hybrid search for RAG pipelines.

conceptMappings.why: Purpose-built vector store for retrieval-augmented generation at scale.
Can serve as long-term semantic memory store for agent context retrieval.

products.name: ChromaDB
products.rationale: Open-source embedding database for AI applications. Runs embedded or as a server with collections, metadata filtering, and multi-modal embeddings. Popular for local RAG development.

conceptMappings.why: Lightweight vector store optimized for developer experience in RAG prototyping and production.
Collection-based storage suitable for agent memory with metadata-filtered retrieval.

products.name: LlamaIndex
products.rationale: Data framework for building RAG and knowledge-augmented LLM applications. Provides data connectors, indexing strategies, query engines, and agentic RAG patterns.

conceptMappings.why: Purpose-built framework for retrieval-augmented generation with advanced indexing and query strategies.
Query engine tools enable agent-driven retrieval across heterogeneous data sources.

products.name: Guardrails AI
products.rationale: Input/output validation framework for LLM applications. Provides validators for hallucination, toxicity, PII, bias, and custom rules via the Guardrails Hub.

conceptMappings.why: Purpose-built guardrail framework with validator hub for content safety, PII, toxicity, and hallucination detection.

products.name: NeMo Guardrails
products.rationale: Programmable guardrails toolkit using Colang DSL. Defines conversational rails for topical control, safety, fact-checking, and jailbreak prevention in LLM applications.

conceptMappings.why: DSL-driven guardrail system with programmable rails for input/output control and dialogue safety.

products.name: Prometheus
products.rationale: Time-series metrics collection and alerting system. Pull-based scraping, PromQL query language, and AlertManager. Industry standard for infrastructure and application monitoring.

products.name: Grafana
products.rationale: Observability dashboard and visualization platform. Connects to Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, and other data sources. Provides alerting, annotations, and team dashboards for monitoring agent systems.

products.name: OpenTelemetry
products.rationale: Vendor-neutral observability framework for traces, metrics, and logs. Provides SDKs, collectors, and semantic conventions. The emerging standard for instrumenting AI/agent systems.

products.name: HashiCorp Vault
products.rationale: Secrets management and encryption platform. Dynamic secrets, PKI, transit encryption, and identity-based access. Critical L6 substrate for securing agent credentials and API keys.

conceptMappings.why: Secrets management and identity-based access control for agent credentials and API keys.

products.name: DSPy
products.rationale: Programming framework for optimizing LLM prompts and pipelines. Replaces hand-tuned prompts with compiled, optimized modules using teleprompters and metrics-driven prompt tuning.

conceptMappings.why: Module-based pipeline composition with automatic prompt optimization as the control loop.

products.name: Cursor
products.rationale: AI-native code editor forked from VS Code. Provides inline chat, multi-file editing, codebase-aware completions, and agent mode for autonomous coding tasks.

conceptMappings.why: Agent mode orchestrates multi-step coding tasks with tool use and file editing.
Terminal execution, file operations, and web search as tool invocations.

products.name: GitHub Copilot
products.rationale: AI pair programmer with inline suggestions, chat, and agent mode. Integrates into VS Code, JetBrains, and CLI. Coding agent can create PRs from issue descriptions.

conceptMappings.why: Agent mode uses MCP tools, terminal commands, and file operations for autonomous coding.
